instances.overview:
Resharded version of [Intel’s Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-W4A16-AutoRound](https://huggingface.co/Intel/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-W4A16-AutoRound), prepared for faster loading and prefetching on Kaggle. The original weights are unchanged, including the BF16 PLE table; only their distribution across safetensors files has changed.

The model remains subject to the original **Qwen Community License 1.0 (`qwen-community-1.0`)**. All credit for the model and quantization goes to Qwen and Intel.
